# Autonomous Agent Instructions (H 线：沙雕宗门经营 + 修仙群聊直播间)

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), [`BACKLOG.md`](../BACKLOG.md) and [`docs/design/H-sect-comedy-guide.md`](../docs/design/H-sect-comedy-guide.md) first. Execute the H-track in order (`H1-1 → … → H5-3`), one commit per task: starter sect, quirky disciples, morning job assignment, per-disciple comedic reports, sect growth, comedy templates, recurring gag NPCs, group chat / moments / livestream with optional LLM, leader and sock-puppet posting. Tone: classical xianxia with moderate humor. Settlement stays deterministic; character speech may exaggerate but affects the world only via structured intents. Verify with `npm run verify`, update BACKLOG and CHANGELOG, commit and push to `origin main`, then continue immediately.
